historical_view.note: Round-2 evidence/pair-joint/LLM/hybrid/repair are not in this historical summary.

model.direction: delta = model_a minus model_b; positive means model_a higher

within_model.direction: delta = strategy_a minus strategy_b; positive means strategy_a higher

static_feasibility.note: Tier A static tools need a complete translation unit. The 160 SecVulEval functions are extracted fragments; the existing 3-snippet CWE-401 smoke is not a benchmark. A4 remains planned and no static F1 is reported.

juliet_llm_hybrid.note: This tool reproduces the 12 legacy runs only. Round-2 evidence/pair-joint/LLM/hybrid/repair are in final_summary.json and LEADERBOARD.md.

settings.bootstrap_cohort: common-valid units for paired comparisons; cluster by project (detection) or pair_id (pair)
settings.mcnemar: exact two-sided on paired correctness; secondary evidence
settings.cost_policy: USD from per-request usage at the prices recorded in the runner config; no separate price-snapshot date is stored for DeepSeek, MiMo prices were verified 2026-11-12; full run total includes repair requests, task cost excludes them
settings.latency_policy: request-level latency from the runner attempts; p50/p95 over all records in the model's six runs

limitations: Single run per model/strategy; run-to-run variance is not estimated.
MiMo uses reasoning_effort=none with max_completion_tokens on OpenCode Go; its decoding/transport differs from DeepSeek's non-thinking max_tokens setup.
Detection negatives are source-unlabelled, not proven safe; pair fixed sides are also unlabelled.
CWE-401 has only 3 test functions; no per-CWE claim is made.
McNemar assumes independent units; project/pair clustering can make p-values anti-conservative, so cluster-bootstrap intervals are the primary evidence.
Derived runs are read-only views over runner/runs/test_v1_*; they are not new model calls.
Price snapshots are not identical: DeepSeek prices come from the runner config, MiMo prices were verified on the OpenCode Go page on 2026-11-12.
